description: session.compact: replaces compaction with the observation ledger, cut at the background watermark within one total budget (a /compact row after the context does not discard it, and a context that differs from the history keeps it up to the first differing row), with a session brief compiled by code where the Observer's memory cannot stand, carrying the user's constraints in force (standing rules only; an approval never replaces one), a continuation record written as a handoff, led by a Session line naming the session's goal and the assistant's role that a background Luna call writes, with the git state, and the /compact instructions; prompt.section: a standing note on compaction and how to resume; turn.start and turn.complete: time the main conversation's prompts and answers and observe it in the background through pi; turn.step: observe mid-turn during a long turn, however long the history grows; session.start and store.set: prune sessions untouched for 30 days, and the oldest when the store is full; session.start, tool.call and command.run: the om_recall and om_stats tools and /om-stats (usage statistics, one file per session); classic.SessionStart and classic.Stop: record the transcript path, and a compaction's SessionStart asks again for tool.describe, which keeps om_recall out of the deferred tools once the session has compacted; session.end: ends the loop's background work and a /clear drops the session's state; skill.prompt: records the skills the session loads and when; turn.start also keeps the main conversation's last three turn starts, and a skill invoked before them is carried as one line
